videos.headline: Dwight Phillips Jr. finds the end zone for 15-yard TD
Gunner Stockton throws 24-yard TD pass to Lawson Luckie for Georgia
Christian Neptune finds Keshaun Singleton for a TD to get Auburn on the board
Chas Nimrod brings in an incredible one-handed catch in the end zone for an Auburn TD
Byrum Brown finds the end zone for Auburn
